references.title: Dominantly inherited alzheimer network trial: an opportunity to prevent dementia. A study of potential disease modifying treatments in individuals at risk for or with a type of early onset alzheimer's disease caused by a genetic mutation. Master protocol DIAN-TU-001

characteristics.name: Study name
characteristics.value: Dominantly Inherited Alzheimer Network Trial: An Opportunity to Prevent Dementia. A Study of Potential Disease Modifying Treatments in Individuals at Risk for or With a Type of Early Onset Alzheimer's Disease Caused by a Genetic Mutation. Master Protocol DIAN-TU-001 (DIAN-TU)

characteristics.name: Methods
characteristics.value: Phase II/III Multicenter Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Platform Trial

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
Individuals with known Alzheimer's disease-causing mutations or who are unaware of their genetic status have DIAD mutation in their family.

Cognitively normal or with mild cognitive impairment or mild dementia, CDR of 0-1 (inclusive)

characteristics.name: Interventions
characteristics.value:
Gantenerumab SC every 4 weeks at escalating doses 

Placebo SC every 4 weeks

Solanezumab IV every 4 weeks at escalating doses

PLacebo IV every 4 weeks

characteristics.name: Outcomes
characteristics.value:
- Dementia severity

- Cognitive function

- Functional ability

- Serious adverse events

- Mortality

Important: Behavioural symptoms improvement

references.title: A Study of Different Donanemab (LY3002813) Dosing Regimens in Adults With Early Alzheimer's Disease (TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 6)

characteristics.name: Study name
characteristics.value: Investigating the Effect of Different Donanemab Dosing Regimens on ARIA-E and Amyloid Lowering in Adults With Early Symptomatic Alzheimer's Disease

characteristics.name: Methods
characteristics.value: Randomized , double-blind, phase 3b study

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
Individuals with early symptomatic AD (gradual and progressive change in memory function reported by the participant or informant for ≥6 months; a MMSE score of 20 to 28 (inclusive) at screening; amyloid PET scan result from central read, consistent with the presence of amyloid pathology).

-60 Years to 85 Years

characteristics.name: Interventions
characteristics.value:
1400 mg Donanemab IV, placebo IV with different regimen:

Standard Regimen (donanemab 700 mg IV baseline week 4, 8; placebo IV at week 2,6,10,14; donanemab 1400 mg week 12,16,20, 24)

Dose skipping (700 mg donanemab IV at baseline; placebo IV at week 2, 4, 6, 10, and 14; 1400 mg of donanemab IV at week 8, 12, 16, 20, and 24)

Titration (350 mg donanemab IV at baseline; placebo IV at week 2, 6, 10, and 14; 700 mg donanemab IV at week 4; 1050 mg of donanemab IV at week 8; 400 mg of donanemab IV at week 12, 16, 20, and 24).

Maximum Concentration (350 mg donanemab IV at baseline, weeks 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10; 700 mg donanemab IV at weeks 12 and 14; 1400 mg of donanemab IV at weeks 16, 20, and 24)

Duration: up to 76 weeks

characteristics.name: Outcomes
characteristics.value:
-Amyloid-related imaging abnormality (ARIA)

-Symptomatic ARIA-Eor ARIA-H

-Serious adverse events (SAEs)

-Mortality
